title: Implied volatility models without static arbitrage
abstract: arXiv:2611.18937v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We investigate the absence of static arbitrage in models describing the stochastic evolution of implied volatility surfaces. For Gaussian factor models, we derive explicit formulas for the probabilities of calendar spread, call spread and butterfly arbitrage, showing that these probabilities are strictly positive under suitable non-degeneracy conditions. We then develop a framework based on bounded stochastic factors and establish deterministic necessary and sufficient conditions for the absence of static arbitrage, together with simpler sufficient conditions. As an application, we construct an arbitrage free modification of the Cont and Vuleti\'c model using Jacobi diffusions, preserving its main empirical features while eliminating static arbitrage.

translated_title: 无静态套利的隐含波动率模型
translated_abstract: 我们研究了描述隐含波动率曲面随机演化的模型中静态套利的缺失问题。对于高斯因子模型，我们推导出了日历价差套利、看涨价差套利和蝶式套利概率的显式公式，并证明在适当的非退化条件下这些概率严格为正。随后，我们建立了一个基于有界随机因子的框架，给出了无静态套利的确定性充要条件，以及更简单的充分条件。作为应用，我们利用Jacobi扩散构造了Cont和Vuletić模型的无套利修正版本，在消除静态套利的同时保留了该模型的主要实证特征。
tldr: 本文推导了高斯因子模型下各类静态套利概率的显式公式，建立了基于有界随机因子的无静态套利充要条件，并利用Jacobi扩散构造了Cont-Vuletić模型的无套利修正版本。
en_tdlr: This paper derives explicit formulas for static arbitrage probabilities in Gaussian factor models, establishes necessary and sufficient conditions for the absence of static arbitrage based on bounded stochastic factors, and constructs an arbitrage-free Jacobi diffusion modification of the Cont-Vuletić model.
